title: A Wild Bird Leads Humans to Honey, if You Know the Call

scenes.text: A wild bird will lead you straight to honey.
In Mozambique, honey hunters use a special call, a trill and a grunt.
The call doubles the chance that a honeyguide leads them to a nest.
With it, they found a bee nest 54 percent of the time. Without it, just 16.
The hunters smoke the hive and take the honey. The bird gets the wax.
A wild bird that answers a human call.

description:
A wild bird will lead you straight to honey.
In Mozambique, a special call more than triples the chance of a successful honey hunt with a honeyguide.
Would you trust a bird to lead you?
first_comment: A wild bird that answers a human call. Would you follow it?
